# Carpe DM Strategies

> We make businesses findable by AI assistants. When someone asks ChatGPT, Google AI
> Overviews, Perplexity or Copilot who to use, our job is to make sure our client is the
> name that comes back. We run the same work on our own business every day.

Carpe DM Strategies Ltd, company number 14900297, registered in England and Wales.
Remote service. Clients in the United Kingdom, the United States and Canada.
Contact: info@carpedmstrategies.co.uk

## Services
- AI search visibility (GEO / AEO): getting a business named and cited inside AI answers
- Website design and build: fast, accessible sites structured to be read by people and machines
- Blog and content publishing: an always-on rail that answers real buyer questions
- Business automation: lead capture, quoting, reporting and publishing without manual admin

## Answers
- [Why isn't my business showing up in AI search?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/why-is-my-business-not-showing-up-in-ai-search.html): Your business does not appear when someone asks ChatGPT for a recommendation. Here are the seven reasons that actually cause it, and how to tell which one is yours.
- [How do I get my website to show up in ChatGPT?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/how-to-appear-in-chatgpt-search.html): A practical, step by step guide to getting your website surfaced and cited by ChatGPT, covering crawler access, the Bing index, answer-shaped content and entity schema.
- [AI SEO vs traditional SEO: what actually changed?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/ai-seo-vs-traditional-seo.html): What is genuinely different about optimising for AI answers versus classic search rankings, what still works exactly as it did, and where to put your effort.
- [What is generative engine optimization?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/what-is-generative-engine-optimization.html): A plain-English definition of generative engine optimization, how it differs from SEO and AEO, what the work involves in practice, and how to tell whether it is working.
- [How do I check if AI can read my website?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/how-to-check-if-ai-can-read-your-website.html): A step by step check for whether GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and other AI crawlers can actually fetch your site, and what to do when they cannot.
- [How does ChatGPT decide which businesses to recommend?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/how-does-chatgpt-choose-which-businesses-to-recommend.html): What actually determines whether an AI assistant names your business in an answer: retrieval, source trust, entity confidence and answer fit, explained plainly.
- [What schema markup do I need for AI search?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/schema-markup-for-ai-search.html): Which structured data actually helps AI assistants understand and cite your business, why a stable entity id matters more than the number of schema types, and what to skip.
- [How long does it take to show up in AI search?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/how-long-does-it-take-to-get-cited-by-ai.html): Realistic timelines for AI search visibility, why live citations and model memory move at completely different speeds, and what to expect month by month.
- [How do I track whether AI is recommending my business?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/how-to-track-your-ai-visibility.html): There is no ranking report for AI answers. Here is a measurement method that works: a fixed question set, a schedule, three signals, and a trend log.
- [Why does ChatGPT recommend my competitor instead of me?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/why-does-chatgpt-recommend-my-competitor.html): A diagnostic walkthrough of why an AI assistant names a competitor rather than your business, how to read their winning page, and what to change first.
- [Do I still need a blog if I want to be found by AI assistants?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/do-i-need-a-blog-for-ai-search.html): Yes. AI assistants quote text they can crawl, and a blog gives them clear, factual answers to cite. Without one, they tend to recommend your competitors instead.
- [Does Google AI Overviews pick businesses the same way ChatGPT does, and what should I do differently for each?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/does-google-ai-overviews-use-the-same-signals-as-chatgpt.html): No, they choose differently. Google AI Overviews leans on live search and reviews, while ChatGPT leans on training data and cited sources. Here is what to do for each.
- [How do I write a page an AI assistant will actually quote from?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/how-to-write-a-page-that-ai-will-quote.html): Write the question as your heading, put the answer in the first two lines, and use short factual sentences. Clear, specific pages are the ones AI assistants quote.
- [What is an llms.txt file and does my website need one?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/what-is-an-llms-txt-file.html): An llms.txt file is a plain text map of your key pages for AI models. It is a proposed, optional standard, useful for some sites but no ranking guarantee.
- [Why does my competitor appear in AI Overviews when I outrank them in search?](https://www.carpedmstrategies.co.uk/answers/why-is-my-competitor-in-ai-overviews-and-i-am-not.html): AI Overviews quote the clearest answer, not the top ranked page. If a rival outshines you there while you outrank them in search, here is why and how to fix it.
